items.why: Bitcoin dropped as Iranian tanker attacks pushed Brent above $101, lifting Treasury yields and the dollar, while about $700M of leveraged long positions were liquidated.
Meta fell with the broader tape, giving back some of its recent AI-optimism gains. No fresh negative company headline today.
Small caps underperformed as 24-year-high Treasury yields raised borrowing cost pressure and investors de-risked ahead of the FOMC minutes.
No single headline; bucking the tape on AI earnings optimism as investors position for a strong reporting season driven by AI spending.

market_note: FOMC minutes from the September meeting land this afternoon; the 10-year yield hit a 24-year high this morning.
summary: Stocks retreated from records as Treasury yields hit a 24-year high, with the Dow off sharply and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower. Surging oil after Iranian tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and caution ahead of the FOMC minutes kept pressure on.
